description: Validate many pieces of untrusted text in one call (processed in parallel server-side). Use for bulk pre-screening, indexing pipelines, or checking a batch of retrieved documents. Returns one verdict per input, in order.

prompts.description: Array of untrusted texts to validate (max 100).

sensitivity.description: Optional. Omit to use the account default. 'no_judgement' blocks only clear attacks, for apps whose users tell the AI exactly what to write. 'balanced' is an older name for it. 'strict' and 'lenient' are accepted for existing callers.

name: validate_prompts
title: Batch-validate multiple prompts
